# payzum/payzum-php (PHP SDK)

> Official PHP SDK for Payzum, a multi-chain crypto payment processor. Create
> invoices, read buyer status with exact decimals, and verify the three
> families of signed webhooks — with the signature header names fixed
> internally so they cannot be misconfigured.

Install: `composer require payzum/payzum-php` (PHP ≥ 8.1, ext-curl, zero
runtime dependencies).

## Start here
- Quickstart and webhook handler examples: README.md in this repository
- Full platform reference for agents (REST, webhooks, payouts, x402):
  https://merchant.payzum.com/llms-full.txt — SDK quickstarts are its §0
- API docs for humans: https://merchant.payzum.com/docs

## What the SDK guarantees
- Webhook verification: `verifyPaymentIpn` (HMAC-SHA-512, `x-nowpayments-sig`),
  `verifyCoinPaymentsIpn` (HMAC-SHA-512, `HMAC`, form-encoded),
  `verifyMassPayout` (HMAC-SHA-256, `X-Payzum-Signature`). Constant-time
  compare, raw-bytes verification, 10-minute replay window where the payload
  carries a timestamp. Do NOT swap headers between families.
- Amounts never touch a float: `Json::decodeLossless` hands every number back
  as an exact decimal string; outbound amounts keep every digit you supplied.
- `Client::createPayment` is never auto-retried without an Idempotency-Key;
  with one, the retry waits out the API's ~60s idempotency consistency window.
- All 16 API error codes typed on `ApiException::$errorCode`; only
  RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED, INTERNAL_ERROR and RATE_PROVIDER_DOWN are retried.
- Canonical `PaymentStatus` enum: waiting | partially_paid | finished |
  expired | failed, with mappers from both the merchant and buyer vocabularies.
- The five IPN event types are listed in `Verifier::IPN_EVENT_TYPES`,
  including the security-relevant `wrong_token_received` and
  `suspicious_token_received`.

## Environments
- Production: `https://merchant.payzum.com` (note: `api.payzum.com` does NOT
  serve the API)
- Sandbox: `https://staging.payzum.com` — `Payzum::sandbox($apiKey)`

## Siblings
- Node.js/TypeScript SDK: https://github.com/payzum-dev/payzum-node (`payzum` on npm)
- Shared OpenAPI contract and signature-vector corpus:
  https://github.com/payzum-dev/payzum-openapi
